name: omaseed
author: Diogo Chaves
description: Torrent activity, alternative speed limits, adding and seeding stats from the omaseed app, in the bar.

barWidget.description: omaseed's mark as the activity readout, with optional speeds. Left click opens the popup: speeds, add, your share, keeping alive, in flight and lately. Needs the omaseed app.

schema.label: Show the mark
schema.description: The omaseed mark as the activity readout: the lower arrow lights while downloading, the upper one while uploading. Mark and speed can both be on, never both off: with both off the mark shows.

schema.label: Show the speed
schema.description: The speed beside the mark in a horizontal bar, under it in a vertical one.

schema.label: Mark colour
schema.description: directions: the theme's blue for in and green for out, as the app's arrows. single: the accent for both.

schema.label: Hide while nothing moves
schema.description: The widget leaves the bar while nothing downloads or uploads. An unreachable server still shows.

schema.label: Few seeds means at most
schema.description: What "keeping alive" counts: complete torrents whose swarm has this many seeds or fewer, you included.

schema.label: Rows in lately
schema.description: Completions and ratio milestones in the popup. 0 hides the section.

schema.label: Middle click
schema.description: Toggle the alternative speed limits, open omaseed, or nothing.
